verzen.tekst: Have mercy upon us, O Lord the God of all, and look at us with favour;
verzen.html: Have mercy upon us, O Lord the God of all, and look at us with favour;

verzen.tekst: and send your fear upon all the nations.
verzen.html: and send your fear upon all the nations.

voetnoten.tekst: The remainder of this verse is omitted by the best authorities.

verzen.tekst: Lift up your hand against the foreign nations
verzen.html: Lift up your hand against the foreign nations

verzen.tekst: As you showed your holiness in us before them,
verzen.html: As you showed your holiness in us before them,

verzen.tekst: Let them know you, as we also have known you,
verzen.html: Let them know you, as we also have known you,

verzen.tekst: Show new signs, and work various wonders.
verzen.html: Show new signs, and work various wonders.

verzen.tekst: Raise up indignation and pour out wrath.
verzen.html: Raise up indignation and pour out wrath.

verzen.tekst: Hasten the time and remember your oath.
verzen.html: Hasten the time and remember your oath.

verzen.tekst: Let him who escapes be devoured by raging fire.
verzen.html: Let him who escapes be devoured by raging fire.

verzen.tekst: Crush the heads of the rulers of the enemies
verzen.html: Crush the heads of the rulers of the enemies

verzen.tekst: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together,
verzen.html: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together,

verzen.tekst: O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by your name,
verzen.html: O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by your name,

verzen.tekst: Have compassion upon the city of your sanctuary,
verzen.html: Have compassion upon the city of your sanctuary,

verzen.tekst: Fill Zion. Exalt your oracles
verzen.html: Fill Zion. Exalt your oracles

verzen.tekst: Give testimony to those who were your creatures in the beginning,
verzen.html: Give testimony to those who were your creatures in the beginning,

verzen.tekst: Reward those who wait for you,
verzen.html: Reward those who wait for you,

verzen.tekst: Listen, O Lord, to the prayer of your servants,
verzen.html: Listen, O Lord, to the prayer of your servants,

verzen.tekst: The belly will eat any food,
verzen.html: The belly will eat any food,

verzen.tekst: The mouth tastes meats taken in hunting,
verzen.html: The mouth tastes meats taken in hunting,

verzen.tekst: A contrary heart will cause heaviness.
verzen.html: A contrary heart will cause heaviness.

verzen.tekst: A woman will receive any man,
verzen.html: A woman will receive any man,

verzen.tekst: The beauty of a woman cheers the countenance.
verzen.html: The beauty of a woman cheers the countenance.

verzen.tekst: If kindness and humility are on her tongue,
verzen.html: If kindness and humility are on her tongue,

verzen.tekst: He who gets a wife gets his richest treasure,
verzen.html: He who gets a wife gets his richest treasure,

verzen.tekst: Where no hedge is, the property will be plundered.
verzen.html: Where no hedge is, the property will be plundered.

verzen.tekst: For who would trust a nimble robber who skips from city to city?
verzen.html: For who would trust a nimble robber who skips from city to city?
